# $crav1-model-data

lane: cross-cutting | group: Keep the picture current | starter: no | stage: stable | since: 1.118.0 | prompts: 6
purpose: Build or revise one data model from the project's specs, with a manual flow or an auto flow.
use_when: You want a data model from the specs
prompt_note: Manual-flow: the flow question only when the word is absent, one scope confirmation, one batch of decision-changing questions, business-model confirmation, physical-design confirmation, and one closing yes for the spec link. Auto-flow: one budget approval (20 minutes and 5 shared correction passes, or the numbers the user sets) and no intermediate confirmation. A value the user left out is outside the budget.
reads: Reads the specs and system notes the scope includes, the saved model when one exists, and the sources it pinned. It does not read production data.
writes: Writes `docs/data-model/<model>/` through `scripts/model_run.py`: confirmed snapshots, proposed revisions, questions, comparisons, sources, `history.md` when an item is revised, an auto checkpoint when a run stops, and nothing else. After a yes it may add only the line `Data model: docs/data-model/<model>/` on a relevant spec. `report-data-model-full` on `$crav1-what-do-we-know-about-this` writes the review snapshot.
leaves alone: Leaves spec requirements, schema, migration code, and the confirmed model alone until an explicit approval of that stage and revision. Refuses a hand edit of a model file.
limits: No flow word asks, and a headless run with no word stops. An open auto run cannot approve. A tie is not given a winner. Unknown feasibility is not an exclusion. A hand edit is not a revision.
flow:
- `$crav1-model-data` is one skill with `manual-flow` and `auto-flow`.
- Auto flow, after a shown budget of 20 minutes and 5 shared correction passes, keeps every unconfirmed result a proposal, including conditional physical detail.
- The saved model is `docs/data-model/<model>/`.
- `Approved:` names the exact stage and revision.
- Both flows call `scripts/model_run.py` in this skill.
- `revise` records a new version of a decision, worked example, question, or diagram, keeps the previous text in `history.md`, and sets the item back to proposed (a question stays open).
- A hand edit is refused until it is redone with `revise`.
- On Windows run `py -3`, elsewhere `python3`, and try the other if the first is missing.
- Content goes through `--input` or `--text-file`.
- The fields are in `references/inputs.md`.

## Choice words
- question: Which flow
  - `manual-flow`: Confirm scope, then the business model, then physical design. An optional scope value may follow the word.
  - `auto-flow`: After the budget is approved, run every step. Unconfirmed results stay proposals. An optional scope value may follow the word.
  note: The scope is an optional value, not the characters [scope]. Neither the area view nor the platform view is the default.
called_by: Called by the user.
runs by itself: Calls no skill. It may name `$crav1-add-to-spec`, `$crav1-what-do-we-know-about-this`, and `$crav1-finalize-commit`.
you run next: $crav1-finalize-commit; $crav1-what-do-we-know-about-this report-data-model-full <model>; $crav1-add-to-spec
first: `$crav1-model-data manual-flow <optional scope, or leave it out>`
walkthrough: from-model-data.md
